axes.label: Single-target and area enemy Magic removal

notes: Mass Dispel removes multi-target Paralyzing Shots, while Purify Disease removes Regurgitate after a failed Rav'i frontal.
Dominate Mind can stop eligible Humanoid or Dragonkin casts and Mind Soothe can enable route-dependent skips, but the guide does not yet assert a stable target or route.
Mass Dispel removes Bloodthorn Roots from multiple players. Dispersion is a self-only fallback that removes or immunes the root while active.
Dominate Mind and Mind Soothe remain route-dependent on eligible creature types rather than universal dungeon answers.
Mass Dispel removes harmful Cryo Surge and Glacial Torment effects and can offensively remove the eligible Healing Breeze buff.
Dominate Mind and Mind Soothe are exploratory, creature-restricted route tools; no Disease application is listed.
Mass Dispel removes Seduction after a missed stop and handles Corroding Spittle on the mana wyrms and Kystia encounter.
Dominate Mind and Mind Soothe may affect eligible Humanoids, but no stable target or skip is asserted until route evidence exists.
Mass Dispel is backup friendly Magic removal for Melt Armor when the healer cannot cover it.
Dominate Mind can temporarily stop an eligible non-Demonic, non-Mechanical, non-Undead target. Mind Soothe does not apply to the dungeon's Aberrations, so it is not route coverage here.
Mass Dispel removes Imbued Conduction and has additional offensive Magic-removal value, although the guide does not name those enemy buffs.
Dominate Mind and Mind Soothe remain eligible-creature and route dependent; no Disease application is listed.
Mass Dispel covers the named player dispel and offensively removes Bound by Shadow, Captain's Bulwark, and Unholy Mending; removing Bound by Shadow immediately kills the affected Minion of Zul.
Dominate Mind does not work on Undead beings, and Mind Soothe does not affect Undead, so neither is treated as King's Rest route coverage.
Mass Dispel can cover Cold Claws, Stormslam, and paired Rolling Thunder applications when the healer needs help.
Dispel Magic or Mass Dispel removes Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier; Dominate Mind and Mind Soothe remain target- and route-dependent on eligible enemies.

recommendations: Psychic Scream controls clustered orbs and Mass Dispel removes up to five enemy Magic effects; these are control and purge interactions, not friendly cleansing.
Swap immediately to the emissary and use Shadow Word: Death against its one remaining health after the shield is depleted.
Move predictably with your orbiting orb and collect another player's orb.
Mass Dispel can clear the party in an emergency; Purify Disease can remove two individual applications during the duration, while healing remains the fallback.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of EllipsisPriest's Patch 12.1.0 Shadow Priest dungeon utility and affix recommendations. Talent strings, gear, rankings, and comments are intentionally excluded; exploratory Dominate Mind and Mind Soothe ideas remain niche unless a target or route is explicitly supported.
